body.name: mathfrak_H_rob
body.construction: Start from the exact slabwise projected nuisance-product identity; reproduce the missing boundary moments by a finite polynomial system; estimate pilot vectors and Gram moments by bounded-discrepancy minimum-distance projection on sample splits; form bounded off-diagonal corrected pairs; test both point and diffuse within-cell contamination; and bound clean, contaminating, and mixed Hoeffding components under one global \(Q\)-mass budget before optimizing slab and projection resolutions.
